capture: cudaProfilerApi around measured updates only; node-level CUDA graph tracing; CPU sampling/context-switch tracing disabled
scope: Profiler activity totals are diagnostic, may overlap and incur tracing overhead; not unprofiled wall-time benchmark results. Grouping uses kernel name prefix; not hardware utilization or roofline analysis.

memory.scope: CUDA current/default process memory-pool accounting only; USED_HIGH/RESERVED_HIGH are exact for each queried pool, not whole-process VRAM; excludes modules/context and other pools. qualification.scope: untimed first complete update; gradients are clipped; weights are post-Adam; snapshot tensors follow original archive order

timing.scope: synchronized complete step: begin/zero, exact-index feed creation+upload, forward+loss, backward, gradient accumulation, norm+clip, Adam+health, device publications, scalar loss readback; excludes archive/setup/qualification snapshots; fixed batch
